gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-syriac-west: Noto Sans Syriac Western reads modern and tidy, its terminals held well away from the stroke and its small letters bulked up like bundled cable. Neon's glowing, uniform line is the louder voice.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-telugu: Glowing and vibrant, Neon draws every letter with one uninterrupted line, like stencil-cut metal. Noto Sans Telugu sits beneath it with a high-set midline and counters that stay connected to the outside.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-oxygen: Oxygen reads contemporary and clean, with curves that never close back on themselves and lowercase nearly matching the capitals in height. And Neon's marker-like constant line gives the pair its glow.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-pathway-extreme: Glowing marker-nib lines, stamped-metal tall lowercase. Pathway Extreme follows with clear openings in its rounded letters and stubby ascenders beside a big x-height, which is the quieter, sturdier half of the pair.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-preahvihear: Preahvihear reads contemporary, its open letter mouth like a pried oyster shell and its x-height lofty. Preahvihear gives plain, generous text shapes, while Neon's bent-paperclip line with no swelling supplies the glow.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-prompt: Neon's glow comes from a line with no modulation between stems and connecting strokes, so every letter looks like bent tubing. Prompt sits below it, oversized and approachable in its small letters.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-pt-sans-caption: Neon's round letters have walls as heavy as its straight ones, giving a glowing, vibrant look at display scale. But PT Sans Caption brings big-bodied lowercase with unclosed, inviting bowls to steady things.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-puritan: Neon draws everything with a monoweight stroke throughout, so its tall, stamped-metal lowercase glows like a lit sign. Puritan then reads clean and approachable, with oversized e and a counters.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-radio-canada: Lit-up tubing above, tidy text below. Neon holds a glowing, uninterrupted line for display, while Radio Canada keeps its tall, full c, s and z and open curve endings working in the text.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-sen: Neon glows with an uninterrupted line and tall stamped-metal lowercase, spaced open between every pair of glyphs. Sen follows modern and tall too, tracing each letter in constant weight.
